name: WayriCAD Mechanical Check
description: Mechanical collision and proximity review with part distances and point rulers.
description_full: Read-only saved-board mechanical validation with optimized exact FreeCAD/Open CASCADE collision and nearest-part searches, manual part-to-part distances, point rulers, closest-approach hover witnesses, board views, optional second PCB placement and cross-sections. Quick 2D uses conservative footprint envelopes and the saved board outline without FreeCAD. Native and offline viewers identify measurement evidence and export HTML/JSON/CSV. KiCad 10 Python/CLI is required; exact solids require FreeCAD Python. IPC checks the saved file and does not capture unsaved edits. KiCad 11 extraction is unverified.
